test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A milkman purchases milk at Rs. 'a' per litre and sells it at Rs. 1.5a per litres. Still he mixes 2 litres water with every 9 litres of pure milk. What is his profit percentage?
solution:
Given:

Cost price of milk = Rs. a per litre

Selling Price = Rs. 1.5a per litre

He mixes 2 litres of water with every 9 litre of pure milk

Formula Used:

Profit = Selling price - Cost price

Profit percent = {[(SP - CP)/CP] × 100}

Where, SP = Selling price and CP = Cost price

Calculation:

According to the question,

Cost price of 9 litres milk = Rs. 9a

Cost price of 2 litres water = Rs. 0

Total cost price of mixture = 9a

Selling price of 9 litres milk and 2 litres water = 11 × 1.5a

⇒ 16.5a

Profit = Selling price - Cost price

⇒ 16.5a - 9a = 7.5a

Profit percent = {[(SP - CP)/CP] × 100}

⇒ (7.5a/9a) × 100 = 250/3%

∴ The profit percentage is 250/3%.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
